verdict.rationale: Khoj ships multiple official surfaces—web, desktop app, Emacs/Obsidian plugins, and WhatsApp as a mobile access point—with docs showing shared chat, search, voice, and slash-command features across some of them (khoj-docs-4, khoj-docs-18, khoj-docs-34, khoj-docs-39). However there's no dedicated native iOS/Android app, and advanced features like automations, agents, and code execution aren't confirmed to be uniformly available across every client (e.g., WhatsApp only lists slash commands, not agents/automations). Missing for 10: confirmed native mobile app, explicit cross-client feature-parity matrix, and independent corroboration that all surfaces (not just chat) work identically.
